verses.text: Ix smolb'an masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj Moisés, ix yalan winh t'a heb': Ex wetchonhab', ab'ek wal tiknaik, ol walkan juntzanh kachnab'il yet' cheknab'il t'ayex, yik scham wal he k'ayb'ani yet' he b'eyb'alani.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal yak'nak jun strato ket'ok t'a lum witz skuchan Horeb.
Manhoknhej yet' heb' ko mam kicham yak'nak strato chi', palta yak'nakpax ket'ok ko masanil a onh molan onh ek' tik.
Ha wal Jehová lolonnak t'ayonh t'a jolom witz chi', kab'nak wal tas yal chi' ayik slolonelta t'a kal k'ak'.
Ha in kan in t'a he nanhal yet' Jehová chi' yik swal t'ayex tas syala', yujto ex xiwk'e t'a jun k'ak' chi', maj ex k'e t'a jolom witz chi', yalan Jehová chi' icha tik:
Ha in Jehová he Diosal in, ex wik'elta t'a Egipto b'aj ayex och chekab'ok, manh eyikok he b'a.
Malajokab' junokxo Dios b'aj tzex och ejmelal, palta anhejokab' t'ayin.
Malajokab' junok yechel junok tas tze b'o'och he diosalok, tas ay t'a satcha'anh, tas ay t'a sat lum tik, ma tastak ay t'a yoltak ha ha'.

Manh ex em nhojan t'ay, manh eyak'em he b'a t'ay, yujto a in Jehová he Diosal in, ste kot wowal t'ayex tato tzex och ejmelal t'a junokxo tasi. Ol wak'och sya'elal heb' mamab'il malaj welk'och t'ay, ol wak'anpax ya'elal t'a yib'anh yuninal heb', yixchikin heb' yet' yinhtilal heb'.
Haxo heb' tzin xajanani, sk'anab'ajan in cheknab'il, ol in xajanej heb' yet' yinhtilal yik ol b'eynhejb'atok.
Manh komonok tze lok in b'i a in Jehová he Diosal in tik, ma tzeyak' b'inaj in b'i t'a junok tas t'a ichnhej ta', yujto ol wak' ya'elal t'a mach icha chi' sk'ulej.
Niwanokab' yelk'och sk'uhal ik'oj ip t'ayex yuj in eyik'ancha'anh, icha ix aj walankan t'ayex.
Wake' k'uhal tzex munlaj t'a he munlajel.

Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, sk'uhal ik'oj ip, wik yaji. Manh ex munlaj t'a jun k'u chi', ma heb' eyuninal, heb' ix eyisil, heb' winh he chekab', ma heb' ix he chekab', nok' he wakax, nok' he chej, ma junokxo nok' he molb'etzal nok', ma heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' t'a he kal, palta masanil heb' syik' yip heyet'ok.
Naekkoti to ek'nakex chekab'wumal t'a Egipto. Ha inxo Jehová he Diosal in tik wik'nakexelta yet' in poder. Yuj chi' swala' to tze k'anab'ajej sk'uhal ik'oj ip.
Ayokab' yelk'och he mam he nun t'a he sat, icha wal ix aj walan t'ayex, yik wach' ol najatb'ok he k 'inal, yik wach' ol ex ajek' t'a sat lum lum ol wak' chi' t'ayex.
Manh he milcham heb' eyetanimail.
Manh ex em ajmulal t'a yol sk'ab' eyetb'eyum junjun ex.
Manh ex elk'anok.
Manh he nak'e lolonel t'a spatik heb' eyetanimail.

Manh he nib'ejoch ix yetb'eyum junokxo mach, spat, slu'um, heb' winh schekab', heb' ix schekab', nok' swakax, nok' sb'uru, ma junokxo tas ay t'a heb' eyetanimail chi', manh he nib'ejochi, xchi Jehová t'ayonh.

Haton wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik te cha'anh ajnak yalanelta Jehová t'a skal jun niwan k'ik'al asun ayoch sk'ak'al, ayik molan onh ek' ko masanil t'a yich lum witz chi'. Anhej wal juntzanh cheknab'il tik yalnak, ichato chi' stz'ib'anoch t'a chab' pachanh k'e'en k'e'en, yak'an t'ayin.

Palta a exxo tik, ayik eyab'an yoch jun jaj chi' t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi', eyilan sk'e nhilnhon k'ak' t'a lum witz chi', masanil ex yajal heyaj t'a junjun eyinhtilal tik yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab', ex jawi eyal t'ayin icha tik:

Wal yel, a Jehová ko Diosal ix sch'ox wal stzikikial yet' yipalil t'ayonh, ix kab' wal slolon t'a skal k'ak'. Ha tiknaik toxo ix nachaj wal el ku'uj tob'an syal slolon Dios t'ayonh anima onh tik, palta ina maj onh chamlaj.
¿Tas yuj sko b'ek ko b'a ko cham yuj jun k'ak' to ayxo smay chi'? Tato ol kab' wal yoch sjaj Jehová ko Diosal junelxo, ol onh chamok.
Malaj wal junok anima syal yab'an yoch sjaj jun Dios pitzan t'a skal k'ak' icha ix kab' a onh tik, yujto ay schamelal.
Wach' a ach tzach och t'a yichanh Jehová ko Diosal chi' yik tzab'an masanil tas syala', slawi chi' tzalan t'ayonh masanil tas syal chi', ol ko k'anab'ajani, xe chi t'ayin.
Ayik wan eyalan chi' t'ayin, wan pax yab'an Jehová tas tzeyal chi', yuj chi' yal t'ayin: Toxo ix wab' tas syal jun chonhab' tik, ix scha in k'ol tas ix yal heb'.
Komonok ichanhej tik spensar heb', aynhej welk'och t'a yol sat heb', sk'anab'ajannhej in cheknab'il heb' yik wach' ol aj sb'eynhejb'at heb' yet' heb' yuninal t'a smasanil tiempo.
Yuj chi' al t'a heb' to smeltzaj heb' t'a scampamento.

Ha hachxo tik, kananh wet' t'a tik, yujto ol wal masanil in cheknab'il t'ayach yet' in k'ayb'ub'al, ol a k'ayb'an heb' t'ay, yik wach' ol sb'eyb'alej heb' b'aj ay lum lum ol wak' chi' t'a heb', xchi Jehová chi' t'ayin.
Yuj chi' b'eyb'alejek masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Manh eyik'el t'a he pensar.
B'eyb'alejek b'eyb'al ix sch'oxkan Jehová ko Diosal, yik te wach'xonhej ol aj he b'eyb'ati, ol najatb'ok he k 'inal t'a sat lum lum ol yak' chi' t'ayex.
